# Age-band modifiers

### AGE-B1-01: Ages 3 to 5 use the product only with an adult in control

**MUST** · Level 2 (Forward-compliant) · Age bands: B1 (3-5) · Detection: static · Effort: medium

**Requirement.** No child account with credentials, no text input, no external links, no notifications to the child, audio-first instructions, and any AI conversation only with an adult present.

**Why.** KIDS Act Art. 14(1)(d) and 15(1)(d): access below 13 only through tools for guardians. Art. 7(4)(b) sets 3 years as the floor for guardian-controlled access to video services.

**How to improve.** Route access through the guardian or teacher device; remove text inputs and outbound links.

**Sources.** [KIDS](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:52026PC0681), [UNCRC-GC25](https://www.ohchr.org/en/documents/general-comments-and-recommendations/general-comment-no-25-2021-childrens-rights-relation)

### AGE-B2-01: Under 10, communication uses preset messages only

**MUST** · Level 2 (Forward-compliant) · Age bands: B1 (3-5), B2 (6-9) · Features: chat, multiplayer · Detection: static · Effort: medium

**Requirement.** No free-text chat. Communication uses preset phrases or emojis. External links are behind an adult gate.

**Why.** DSA Art. 28 guidelines on contact risks; KIDS Act Art. 12 and 15(1)(c).

**How to improve.** Replace chat input with a preset phrase picker.

**Sources.** [DSA-G28](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/library/commission-publishes-guidelines-protection-minors), [KIDS](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:52026PC0681)

### AGE-B3-01: Under 13, access is enabled and controlled by a guardian or the school

**MUST** · Level 2 (Forward-compliant) · Age bands: B1 (3-5), B2 (6-9), B3 (10-12) · Detection: manual · Effort: medium

**Requirement.** Below 13, access to online games and AI conversational features is enabled and controlled through tools for guardians (or the school in educational deployments).

**Why.** KIDS Act Art. 14(1)(d) and 15(1)(d).

**How to improve.** Require a guardian or school account to activate the child's access and settings.

**Sources.** [KIDS](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:52026PC0681)

### AGE-B4-01: Ages 13 to 15 respect the national consent age and limited features

**MUST** · Level 1 (Legal baseline) · Age bands: B4 (13-15) · Detection: manual · Effort: medium

**Requirement.** Where consent is the legal basis, guardian consent is obtained below the national age of digital consent (13 to 16 depending on Member State). Social features follow limited-account rules.

**Why.** GDPR Art. 8. KIDS Act Art. 6(2) for social and video features (13 to 14 only with guardian-set limited accounts).

**How to improve.** Read the national pack for the consent age and add a guardian consent step below it.

**Sources.** [GDPR](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj), [KIDS](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:52026PC0681), [EDPB-CONSENT](https://www.edpb.europa.eu/our-work-tools/our-documents/guidelines/guidelines-052020-consent-under-regulation-2016679_en)

### AGE-B5-01: Ages 16 to 17 keep protective defaults

**SHOULD** · Level 3 (Best practice) · Age bands: B5 (16-17) · Detection: manual · Effort: low

**Requirement.** Older teenagers may change defaults themselves after clear information and explicit choice, but defaults stay protective and profiling-based recommendations stay off by default.

**Why.** KIDS Act Art. 11(2) (changes only above 15 with explicit consent) and 10(2)(b).

**How to improve.** Allow opt-in changes with a plain explanation; keep defaults protective.

**Sources.** [KIDS](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:52026PC0681), [DSA-G28](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/library/commission-publishes-guidelines-protection-minors)
